QuestInfo.0: The archeologist, Doctor #p1022006#, currently does research at a camping site in #m102000000#. He recently called me about a strange rumor he heard.
QuestInfo.1:

0.0: Have you heard the rumors?\r\n#b#L0#What rumors?#l
0.1: There are rumors about the Ghost Tree roaming around Perion.\r\n#b#L0#A Ghost Tree? Could there really be a Ghost Tree?#l\n#L1#No way, ghosts don't exist.#l
0.2: I guess so. I don't believe the rumors either. However, I've also heard of something else. There is a legend of a tree that has grown in Perion since the olden days. You must have heard about it, right?\r\n#b#L0#Well... I don't recall...#l
0.3: Well, if the tree in question were actually real, then it'd help my research a lot. That said, I don't have enough evidence. Not many know about this particular tree. The Indians of Perion seem to know something, but they won't answer my questions.\r\n#b#L0#Could they be hiding something?#l
0.4: This is why I need your help. I've heard you're closer to the Perion Indians than I am. Would you please help and collect information about that tree?

1.0: Of course there isn't anything like it!
